title: Abba, Shmuel’s paternal grandfather
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Berakhot 18b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.18b.14). A Babylonian, approximately of Rabbi’s generation.[^1]

notes.text: In the linked story, Shmuel looks for his father, Abba bar Abba. That patronymic supplies the basis for Hyman’s heading “Abba, Shmuel’s paternal grandfather.” Hyman dates the grandfather approximately to Rabbi’s generation.
